# Get Reminder Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given reminder.

## Syntax

~~~~text
reminderDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, reminder: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
reminderDetail(detail: Is Flagged, reminder: reminders)
~~~~
